name: lemure
lore:
Imagine the Nine Hells, a realm of eternal torment and rigid hierarchy. At the very bottom, barely clinging to existence, are the lemures. These wretched souls, once mortals consumed by wickedness, have been reduced to formless masses of molten flesh, their bodies perpetually shivering in anguish. They are the building blocks of Hell's armies, the fuel for its infernal engines, and the playthings of its cruel overlords.

Lemures are the embodiment of despair, their faces forever contorted in a silent scream. Though remnants of their past lives may flicker in their melting features, they are now mindless drones, driven only by the instinct to lash out at the cosmos that condemned them. Only the telepathic commands of their devil masters can restrain their rage, forcing them into formation as they are hurled into the endless Blood War against the demons.

Yet, even in this state of utter degradation, a spark of ambition remains. Lemures possess an innate understanding that they can rise through the ranks of Hell, transforming into something more powerful, more terrible. This faint hope, coupled with the constant agony of their existence, makes them both pitiable and terrifying – a reminder that even the most debased soul can still yearn for something more, even if that something is pure, unadulterated evil.
